headline: Chile Industrial Output Drops 2.7% in September on Weaker Copper Production
summary: Chilean overall industrial production fell 2.7% year-on-year in September due to weaker copper output, despite factory activity gaining 2.0% and retail sales advancing 4.4%.
why: Chile is the world's leading copper producer, making its mining and industrial output data a key input for global metals markets and economic activity tracking.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: A 2.7% drop in Chilean industrial production was driven by weakness in the country's copper mining sector.
